s.note: the grape soda cap badge Ellie gives Carl
s.how: Soak 6 gelatine leaves. Warm 500ml grape juice with 2 tbsp sugar and a squeeze of lemon and stir in the gelatine. Set in small round moulds for 3 hours. Turn out and top each with a dot of whipped cream.

s.n: Wilderness Explorer honey trail mix bars
s.how: Heat the oven to 170C and line a 20 x 30cm tin. Toast 250g rolled oats for 10 minutes. Warm 150g honey, 120g peanut butter and 60g butter until smooth. Stir in the oats, 80g roasted peanuts, 80g sultanas and 50g crushed banana chips, cool for 10 minutes, then fold in 80g chocolate chips. Press firmly into the tin and bake for 15 minutes. Cool completely before cutting into squares.

m.note: the explorer's dinner, served by his dogs
m.how: Roast a 1.5kg sirloin at 200C to 52C and rest. Roast 1kg potatoes alongside. Reduce 200ml red wine with 300ml stock and whisk in a knob of butter. Steam 300g green beans and toss in butter.

w.note: the giant bird who loves chocolate
w.how: Melt 300g dark chocolate and spread thin on a lined tray. Scatter with 60g toasted hazelnuts, 60g dried cherries and flaky salt. Set and break into shards. Save some for the bird.

d.note: Ellie's club drink, the grape soda cap badge
d.how: Freeze 100g red grapes for 2 hours. Mix 600ml purple grape juice with 400ml chilled soda water and a squeeze of lime. Put 2 scoops of vanilla ice cream in each of 4 tall glasses, then pour the grape soda over slowly so it foams up. Drop in a few frozen grapes and serve with a straw and a long spoon.
